verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway exposes a well-documented public API (OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible endpoint, models endpoint, provider-options, authentication via API key/OIDC), confirmed by both docs and an OpenAPI spec probe, enabling programmatic/agentic use including tool-calling agents. Missing for 10: no independent third-party API client walkthrough or SDK changelog corroborating long-term API stability beyond vendor docs.
